text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek trains hard in preparation for the Sumire Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to win three races in the Classics just to make me smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that goal in mind, she continues to secretly put in extra effort to further her abilities.
